note: Independent rejudgment 2026-11-22 after Router Key (type 9) handling was added to RTRSession.handlePDU. RFC 6810 Section 6.4 requires that after No Data Available, if no other caches are available, the router MUST issue periodic Reset Queries until it gets a new usable load from the cache in protocol version 0. While handlePDU accepts a version-0 Error Report header before response establishment, it never adopts version 0 (rtrVersionMin=1) and syncOnce never retries below version 1, so subsequent Reset Queries stay v1/v2 and no version-0 load can succeed. Adding pduRouterKey staging does not change version-0 support. No test carries this id; the row remains unimplemented.
